cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.rep: Replace Spawners in Structures with Cobblemon Spawners
Replace Any Unspecified Spawners with Default Cobblemon Spawners
Replace Any Blocks With Cobblemon Spawners
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.spa: Spawned Pokemon Must Be Defeated In Battle
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.all: Allow Spawned Pokemon to be Aggressive if Fight or Flight is installed
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.tim: Time till Pokemon Despawn in Ticks
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.ena: This will show extra information for spawner replacement including the pokemon, location, and types of entity blocks replaced.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.bla: A List of structures that will be skipped. Prefix with '#' to denote a structure tag (e.g., '#minecraft:village').
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.rep: Whether to do any spawner replacement at all. If set to false, this will disable all spawner replacement.
Whether to do any spawner replacement in structures. If set to false, this will disable all spawner replacement in structures.
Whether to replace any spawners that are not listed in configuration with a default spawner. If set to false, this will leave spawners that do not have custom spawn data created.
Whether to replace any Blocks with Cobblemon Trial Spawners.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.spa: This determines if Pokemon Spawned by the Spawners can be catchable or not.
This Determines if Pokemon Spawned by the Spawner are able to be defeated outside of a battle.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.all: This allows Spawned Pokemon to be Aggressive and attack players when spawned. If set to true whether Spawned Pokemon can be aggressive or not is left up to the Pokemon's Settings.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.mob: This is what percentage (0.0 - 1.0) Mob Spawners will be replaced, eg: .75 will mean 75% of the mob spawners on average will be replaced. NOTE: This will only apply in newly generated chunks.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.tri: This is what percentage (0.0 - 1.0) Trial Spawners will be replaced, eg: .75 will mean 75% of the trial spawners on average will be replaced. NOTE: This will only apply in newly generated chunks.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.blo: This is what percentage (0.0 - 1.0) Blocks will be replaced, eg: .75 will mean 75% of each Blocks within a structure will be replaced. NOTE: This will only apply in newly generated chunks.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.alp: This is what percentage (0.0 - 1.0) Pokemon spawned will be Alpha Pokemon. eg: .75 will mean there is a 75% chance a pokemon spawned will be an alpha.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.ena: This is if the Pokemon spawned from Cobblemon Trial Spawners will adjust their level based on the players parties around them.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.pok: This will determine the type of level adjustment the pokemon will have. Valid values are AVERAGE or MEDIAN. These values are calculated from all pokemon in each players party within range of the spawner. Default is AVERAGE, unknown values will default to AVERAGE.
cobblemontrialsedition.configuration.tim: This will determine how long pokemon spawned from Trial Spawners will remain until they despawn. The time only matters when the cobblemon are loaded.
